testcase.name: compact grouped attribution remains distinct from reviewed causal business reasons
landmark18 grouped explanations retain their schema across saved model identifiers
business view contains only the final probability and reviewed drivers, with no technical section
saved hypothetical contrasts are never used as business reasons; contract terms are context only
all old comparison variants remain hidden
negative historical delay is described as early payment rather than negative lateness
unstable effects are removed before selecting the three main reasons
only the three largest eligible drivers are shown; neutral effects invent no reason
missing checks, poor support and an unrepresentative reference suppress explanations
a stable label alone cannot justify a direction that crosses zero or an ambiguous value
an explanation must reconstruct and match the probability shown on the invoice
business sentences use stored historical facts, never infer payment quality from invoice count
small effects and missing business review never become reasons, even if SHAP is stable
a withheld larger driver is acknowledged instead of presenting a partial explanation as complete
the row button opens only its saved explanation in a native dialog and cleans up after closing
old plans and unsupported models do not fabricate an attribution
floating-point noise at zero is never displayed as a negative probability
ranking explanation shows its score, peer comparison and distinct probability source
score ties and amount-only policies do not invent probability-based ordering
ranking has its own dialog and old forecasts remain readable
policy summary shows eligibility counts and audit status without claiming causal benefit
large VND and fractional priority scores retain their digits in the table and explanation
an empty contact queue distinguishes deferred debt, no debt and legacy unknown scope
cash UI shows saved provenance, money bridge and both timing scenarios safely as text
T5 UI keeps paid remainder, overdue warning and refunds visible without HTML injection
T5 ledger separates cancelled and replaced amounts from what remains payable
grouping and search use the full saved contributions, with pagination instead of truncation
simulation-only risk and old plans never fabricate a cash shortfall decomposition
